card.name: Break points between joined web text
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a word that sits at a seam where one text chunk ends and unrelated text begins, such as a colon, semicolon or '.-' after a sentence. Also some technical nouns before a hyphen or noun, like 'laser', 'optical' and 'fuel'.

modes.label: Seam punctuation
modes.description: A colon, semicolon, asterisk or similar mark that joins unrelated scraped text after a finished sentence.
